import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.NavigableSet;
import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.TreeSet;


public class C {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner in=new Scanner(System.in);
		PrintWriter out=new PrintWriter(System.out);
		
		int n=in.nextInt();
		int m=in.nextInt();
		TreeSet<Integer> ts=new TreeSet<Integer>();
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++){
			ts.add(i+1);
		}
		int[] mas=new int[n+1];
		for(int i=0; i<m; i++){
			int l=in.nextInt();
			int r=in.nextInt();
			int k=in.nextInt();
			NavigableSet<Integer> sub=ts.subSet(l, true, r, true);
			while(!sub.isEmpty()){
				int cur=sub.pollFirst();
				if(cur!=k){
					mas[cur]=k;
				}
			}
			ts.add(k);
		}
		for(int i=1; i<=n; i++){
			out.print(mas[i]);
			out.print(" ");
		}
		
		out.close();
	}

}
